plugins.name: ukg-bryte
plugins.description: UKG Bryte for Claude — Bring your HR and workforce data into Claude via the public UKG MCP server. Skills: UKG Directory (read-only employee directory, employment details, work location, email, and org-chart/reporting views), and Time Off & Accruals (check balances, submit and track time-off requests, review accrual history, and manager time-off/schedule views). Beta Early Access: UKG customer administrators can apply for access here: https://forms.cloud.microsoft/r/YW9VYAREkN
